purpose: Teach: レーン/バラード/アサ/ファイア/台場/ハロ/冴え/エッジ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、ボーリングのレーン、二人で、絶対、行ったわよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で、絶対、ロマンチック、本気、絶対。
lines.en: When you were young, we really did go bowling together, didn't we? You remember, don't you? It was so romantic.
lines.style: Soft opening, searching backwards through time. Warm, certain voice — not asking if it happened, but inviting her to confirm what he knows. Gentle pace, letting each memory settle. Slight lift at 'romantic' — tender recognition.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。本気で、絶対、結婚式、絶対、バラードの曲、絶対、流れたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で、絶対、感動した、本気、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. And the wedding — they played that ballad, remember? I was so moved. Really, I was.
lines.style: Answering with recognition, not recitation. Warm agreement, then a small pause before naming the feeling. Voice softens on 'moved.' Trailing slightly on the final confirmation, like she's reliving it as she speaks.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖母ちゃん、絶対、アサを、絶対、育てていたわよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で、絶対、本気、本気で。
lines.en: And when you used to grow morning glories, don't you remember? You really did.
lines.style: Gentle insistence, like he's watching her remember alongside him. Medium pace, unhurried. Voice carries quiet delight — not lecturing, but savoring the detail together. Slight emphasis on 'really' with affection, not doubt.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、ファイアキャンプ、絶対、家族で、絶対、行ったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で、絶対、思い出、本気、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: That time we all went camping together — the bonfire with the whole family. You remember that, don't you? Those memories.
lines.style: Soft, present voice — she's not just recalling, she's inside the memory. Warm tone, steady pace. Small pause before 'memories,' like she's holding something precious. Trailing off gently, letting the weight of it sit.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お台場、絶対、まだ、絶対、開発されていない時代、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When Odaiba still wasn't developed yet — back when it was all empty. You remember that time?
lines.style: Voice carries the distance of decades. Slow, deliberate pace — he's painting the picture as he speaks. Open, wondering tone, like he's marveling that those days existed. Slight trailing-off, inviting her into the memory without pushing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 孫が、本気で、絶対、ハロウィン、絶対、楽しんでるわよね、あなた、覚えてる?本気で、絶対、可愛い
lines.en: And our grandchildren enjoying Halloween like that — you see how happy they are? That's something to remember.
lines.style: Gentle shift to the present, but voice still holds warmth from the past. Observant tone, noticing something precious happening now. Slower pace on 'happy' and 'remember,' like she's savoring both then and now together.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃のばあさん、本気で、絶対、冴え冴えとした、絶対、美貌、本気で、絶対、覚えてるよ
lines.en: When you were young, you were so sharp, so beautiful. I remember that clearly.
lines.style: Direct tenderness, no hesitation. Voice steady and sure — this is not nostalgia clouding judgment, it's a fact held gently. Even pace, warm and certain. 'Beautiful' carries the weight of genuine admiration, not flattery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、エッジの効いた、ファッション、絶対、好きだったわよね、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, you had such wonderful style — edgy, interesting. I always loved how you dressed.
lines.style: Answering tenderness with specific praise. Voice warm, conversational but sincere. Medium pace, settling on details — 'style,' 'edgy' — like she's already smiling at the memory. Slight emphasis on 'loved' with genuine affection, trailing off gently.
